 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rlines = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == bg for v in grid[r]) <= w // 2]
    clines = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == bg for r in range(h)) <= h // 2]
    rset, cset = set(rlines), set(clines)

    # Determine the regular separator color from line pixels away from crossings.
    samples = [grid[r][c] for r in rlines for c in range(w) if c not in cset]
    samples += [grid[r][c] for c in clines for r in range(h) if r not in rset]
    line_color = Counter(samples).most_common(1)[0][0] if samples else bg
    markers = {(r, c): grid[r][c] for r in rlines for c in clines
               if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != line_color}
    if not markers:
        return []

    rpos = {r: i for i, r in enumerate(rlines)}
    cpos = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(clines)}
    mr = [rpos[r] for r, c in markers]
    mc = [cpos[c] for r, c in markers]
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = min(mr), max(mr), min(mc), max(mc)
    out = [[bg for _ in range(c1 - c0)] for _ in range(r1 - r0)]
    for i in range(r0, r1):
        for j in range(c0, c1):
            vals = [markers.get((rlines[i], clines[j])),
                    markers.get((rlines[i], clines[j + 1])),
                    markers.get((rlines[i + 1], clines[j])),
                    markers.get((rlines[i + 1], clines[j + 1]))]
            if vals[0] is not None and vals.count(vals[0]) == 4:
                out[i-r0][j-c0] = vals[0]
    return out
"
